backend/main.mo: Defines the main actor for trades, accounts, user profiles, performance metrics, and authorization with CRUD operations and access control checks.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a migration function that updates stored performance metrics by ensuring totalCapital is set to 327.0.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report placeholder with no listed features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each frontend file’s purpose, mostly covering layouts, pages, components, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining global color variables for light and dark themes and applying base styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the TanStack Router with public and admin routes, layouts, and gates, wrapped in theme and site-wide auth providers.
Admin layout with dashboard header and logout handling tied to Internet Identity and React Query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/app/AppHeader.ts: Simple header displaying the site wordmark linking to the homepage.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicFooter: Footer with trading disclaimer and copyright section linking to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicLayout: Public-facing layout including header, nav, background texture, main content area, and footer.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/A: Dialog form for adding or editing managed accounts with validation and mutation handling.
Displays all managed accounts with options to add, edit, and delete using admin mutations.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/C: Uploads and parses CSV trade data, previews valid/invalid rows, and imports trades via mutations.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/M: Fetches and edits performance metrics through a form with update mutation support.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/T: Dialog form for creating or updating trade entries with direction selection and mutation handling.
Renders an admin table for viewing, adding, editing, and deleting trades with loading states and action handlers.
frontend/src/features/admin/hooks/useAdm: Provides React Query mutation hooks for CRUD operations on trades, accounts, and performance metrics with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/features/admin/pages/AdminD: Displays the admin dashboard with tabbed sections for trades, accounts, metrics, and CSV import.
frontend/src/features/admin/utils/csv.ts: Parses CSV trade data into validated objects, collecting valid entries and detailed validation errors.
frontend/src/features/analytics/componen: Renders an SVG equity curve chart with area fill, axes, and dynamic scaling based on equity data.
Displays an SVG bar chart of monthly P&L with dynamic sizing and labels.
Shows a donut chart and legend representing win/loss counts and percentages.
frontend/src/features/analytics/pages/Pe: Loads trades and metrics, computes analytics, and displays monthly P&L, win/loss, and equity curve charts within a styled layout.
frontend/src/features/analytics/utils/an: Provides utility functions to compute monthly PnL, win/loss counts, and equity curve data from trades and performance metrics.
frontend/src/features/auth/components/Ad: A wrapper component that checks admin authentication and shows loading, access denied, or protected content accordingly.
frontend/src/features/auth/hooks/useAdmi: Hook that determines whether the user is authenticated and an admin by querying actor identity and admin status.
frontend/src/features/auth/pages/AdminLo: Admin login screen using Internet Identity, redirecting authenticated admins and showing errors for non-admin users.
frontend/src/features/auth/types.ts: Defines simple auth-related types including AuthStatus and AuthState.
frontend/src/features/data/queries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching performance metrics, trades, and managed accounts from the actor backend.
frontend/src/features/public/components/: Generates a simple synthetic balance growth chart using randomized data and displays it as an SVG area/line graph.
UI component providing month, year, and result filters for trade listings.
Displays a styled table of trades with formatted dates, direction badges, pricing, and P&L coloring.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/HomeP: Public dashboard page showing key performance metrics such as PnL, win rate, and trade count, with loading states.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Manag: Displays managed accounts with balances, risk profiles, and growth charts, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Portf: Shows trade history with filters and a table, applying client-side filtering and loading placeholders.
frontend/src/features/public/utils/maski: Masks account names by revealing only the first two and last two characters.
frontend/src/features/seo/usePageMeta.ts: Sets document title and meta description on mount.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/GateScree: Login screen component collecting username and password with error and loading states.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/SiteWideG: Wraps the app with a gate that checks unlock state and handles login attempts before rendering children.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/useSiteGa: Manages site gate state using sessionStorage and validates credentials for unlocking.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing related queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identities, and lifecycle state.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom light/dark theme variables including chart colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash-based), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL or storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, versioning, and pending feature requests to update totalCapital defaults to 327.
